facts.fact: Adwave states that businesses can run streaming TV ads starting at $30 a day on its platform.
facts.quote: run streaming TV ads starting at $30 a day

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical example, a small business spending $2,000 a month on Google Ads gets 500 clicks and 10 conversions, a 2% conversion rate and $200 cost per customer.
facts.quote: Only 10 of those 500 visitors take action. That's a 2% conversion rate and a $200 cost per customer.

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical example, after the website is fixed with the same $2,000 monthly budget and 500 clicks, 25 visitors convert, a 5% conversion rate and $80 cost per customer.
facts.quote: but now 25 visitors convert. That's a 5% conversion rate and an $80 cost per customer.

facts.fact: The page states that nearly 90% of consumers read online reviews before visiting a business, attributing this figure to BrightLocal.
facts.quote: Nearly 90% of consumers read online reviews before visiting a business, according to BrightLocal.

facts.fact: The page claims that if a website takes more than three seconds to load, nearly half of visitors will leave.
facts.quote: If it takes more than three seconds to load, nearly half your visitors will leave.

facts.fact: According to Harvard Business Review (as cited by AdWave), acquiring a new customer costs five to seven times more than retaining an existing one.
facts.quote: Acquiring a new customer costs five to seven times more than retaining an existing one, according to Harvard Business Review.

facts.fact: AdWave states that streaming TV ads reach viewers on premium content across NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and more than 100 other channels.
facts.quote: Streaming TV ads reach viewers on premium content (NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ other channels).

facts.fact: AdWave says that for websites, a conversion rate of 2 to 5% is a common range for small businesses, with the caveat that it varies by industry and channel.
facts.quote: For websites, 2 to 5% is a common range.

facts.fact: AdWave says that for email campaigns, 1 to 3% click-through rates are typical.
facts.quote: For email campaigns, 1 to 3% click-through rates are typical.

facts.fact: AdWave says service businesses often see 30 to 50% close rates for phone inquiries.
facts.quote: For phone inquiries, service businesses often see 30 to 50% close rates.

facts.fact: AdWave estimates that top-of-funnel changes, such as adding a new advertising channel, can show results in 30 to 60 days.
facts.quote: Top-of-funnel changes (like adding a new advertising channel) can show results in 30 to 60 days.

facts.fact: In its hypothetical dental practice example, the referral discount offered is $50 off the next visit for every friend referred.
facts.quote: You offer a referral discount: $50 off their next visit for every friend they refer.

facts.fact: Adwave says small businesses can start testing CTV advertising's impact on their sales funnel for as little as $30 a day.
facts.quote: With Adwave, you can start testing CTV's impact on your funnel for as little as $30 a day.
